parameters.query:
SELECT ch.clinic_id, ch.id AS channel_id
FROM public.channels ch
WHERE ch.type = 'telegram'
  AND ch.status = 'connected'
  AND ch.is_enabled = true
  AND ch.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND NOT COALESCE((ch.config->>'test_only')::boolean, false)
ORDER BY CASE WHEN ch.config->>'telegram_chat_id' = $1 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, ch.created_at
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO webhook_logs (provider, idempotency_key, payload, status, received_at, workflow_version)
VALUES ('telegram', $1, $2::jsonb, 'pending', now(), 'telegram_native_v1')
ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) WHERE idempotency_key IS NOT NULL
DO UPDATE SET id = webhook_logs.id
RETURNING id, (xmax = 0) AS is_new;
UPDATE webhook_logs SET status = 'ignored', error_message = 'unknown_or_disabled_telegram_channel' WHERE id = $1;

UPDATE webhook_logs
SET status = 'processed',
    clinic_id = $1,
    channel_id = $2,
    processing_time_ms = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - received_at)) * 1000
WHERE id = $3
  AND status = 'pending'
  AND clinic_id IS NULL
  AND channel_id IS NULL
  AND idempotency_key = $4
RETURNING id;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ $('Merge Conversation Data').item.json.clinic_id, $('Merge Conversation Data').item.json.channel_id, $('Log Telegram Webhook').item.json.id, $('Parse Telegram Message').item.json.idempotency_key ] }}

nodes.name: Build K2 Signed Core Envelope
nodes.notes: Creates an HMAC over the exact internal core envelope using the channel signing secret; never emits the secret.

parameters.query: SELECT encode(extensions.hmac($1::text, secret.signing_secret, 'sha256'), 'hex') AS signature FROM public.get_channel_secret_db($2::uuid) AS secret WHERE secret.signing_secret IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ JSON.stringify($('Build K2 Signed Core Envelope').item.json.core_payload || {}), String($('Build K2 Signed Core Envelope').item.json.channel_id) ] }}
